Chezmoi dotfiles: source `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`, target `~/`, repo https://github.com/pascalandy/dotfiles. Sync via `chezmoi apply` (copies, not symlinks). Files in `~/` that are managed by chezmoi should NEVER be edited directly. Always edit the source in `~/.local/share/chezmoi/` or use `chezmoi edit`.
chezmoi managed | grep <filename>
chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc
`dot_`=dotfile; `private_`=600/700; `executable_`=execute; `.tmpl`=template; `run_before_`=before; `run_after_`=every; `run_once_`=first.
chezmoi add ~/.newfile
git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push
Store scripts in `~/.local/bin/`.
code ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chezmoi add ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
Stored as `dot_local/bin/executable_[script-name]`.
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
Script names should NOT have `.sh` extension.
Template: `dot_config/opencode/skill/bash/scripts/pref_bash_script_template.sh`
set -euo pipefail
Functions `fct_*`; logging `log_*`; constants/env `UPPER_CASE`; locals `lower_case`.
Files containing `{{ .variable }}` MUST have `.tmpl` extension. Variables: `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`.
Before solving from scratch, search cass. NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
cass search "authentication error" --robot --limit 5
cass view /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 --json
cass expand /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 -C 3 --json
cass capabilities --json
cass robot-docs guide
stdout = data only, stderr = diagnostics. Exit 0 = success.
